obligations.details: Current worker response is adopted exactly once; duplicate delivery is rejected and settled generations ignore late unconsumed deliveries.
Dispatch, then newer edit/regeneration: late old terminals settle to null adoption with genuine stale rejections.
Evict before delivery via real WorkerPool with held transport: evicted source residency is rejected, readyChunks 15 / failedChunks 1.

Cancel via supersede/dispose/replace: superseded tickets cancelled, in-flight replacement failure settles generation as failed with cancelledJobs recorded. Settled-Ready replacement failure is an explicit contract: readTelemetry Failed (16 ready / 0 failed) while the resolved whenSettled promise preserves Ready.
Forged completed terminal never issued by the pool is rejected before decode/cache/publication via pool-scoped authorizer; cross-pool terminals unauthorized.
Tampered worker epoch and mismatched planning epoch / target / revision / algorithm / source digest rejected with distinct fail-closed codes.
Bounded queue: over-capacity enqueue fails closed with QueueFull; transferable input ownership taken at enqueue and detached after completion.
Pool failure classification preserved through the adoption gate, never coerced to generic failure.
